(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Close Project backups'||x.textContent.trim()==='Close Project backups');if(b)b.click();return b?'closed backups dialog':'no dialog'})()

(async()=>{const req=indexedDB.open('xray-workspace-backups-v1');const db=await new Promise((res,rej)=>{req.onsuccess=()=>res(req.result);req.onerror=()=>rej(req.error)});const store=db.transaction('summaries','readonly').objectStore('summaries');const all=await new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=store.getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)});db.close();const hit=all.find(x=>x&&x.name==='Assistant checkpoint');if(!hit)throw Error('Backup not found among '+all.length);return {backups:all.length,found:{name:hit.name,jobId:hit.jobId,jobRevision:hit.jobRevision,plans:hit.plans,sha256:hit.sha256,sizeBytes:hit.sizeBytes}}})()
